name: Film - MANISH on profile-produced Broken targets

runtime_policy.target_profile: Only targets with an explicit exact break_profile run the content Broken lifecycle; omitted profiles remain unbreakable in this model.
runtime_policy.break_order: A positive-damage packet subtracts its frozen UnbalValue under the gauge hypothesis. Reaching zero applies the content-owned Broken tag after that packet's hit callback, so the packet that triggers Break cannot receive the Jiaojuan conditional bonus.
runtime_policy.conditional_bonus: The projected Jiaojuan Broken ratio joins the additive damage-bonus zone only on packet callbacks while the target's Broken tag is active.
runtime_policy.recovery: At configured broken_duration_us the Broken tag is removed and gauge restores to capacity; a later packet has no conditional damage bonus.
runtime_policy.excluded: No Break Damage, BI settlement, native target profile, gauge conversion, native eligibility, native recovery, or release-availability claim is added.

At 1000 ATK, zero DEF and zero RES, the six settled Edgar receipts are 530, 1075, 3674/5, 3674/5, 7854/5 and 1196. The independent values follow the frozen coefficients and T1 additive-zone ratio.
